metrics.name: Distinction Inventory
metrics.definition: Raw count of distinguishable mismatch candidates.

metrics.name: Admissible Distinction Wealth
metrics.definition: Sigma_D structures capable of lawful participation in continuation.

metrics.name: Realized Distinction Wealth
metrics.definition: Admissible Sigma_D structures actively producing resilience, adaptation, innovation, recovery, or exchange value.

metrics.name: Distinction Loss
metrics.definition: Collapse, erasure, or unrecoverable narrowing of admissible Sigma_D structures.

metrics.name: Distinction Recovery
metrics.definition: Ability to restore Sigma_D structures or regenerate equivalent admissible organization after loss.

metrics.name: Distinction Efficiency
metrics.definition: Effectiveness of converting ADW into RDW.

metrics.name: Distinction Concentration
metrics.definition: Degree to which economic Sigma_D capacity is concentrated into few fragile pathways.

metrics.name: Distinction Wealth Index
metrics.weighted_formula: DWI = w1(ADW) + w2(RDW) + w3(DR) + w4(DE) - w5(DL) - w6(DC_fragility)
